title: City of El Paso 25-park catalogue breadth recovery

selection.rule: Twenty-five largest reviewed current City-owned records categorized City Park in the official Parks FeatureServer, after excluding Memorial Senior Center and Memorial Ballpark as component records that duplicate Memorial Park.

excluded.name: Memorial Senior Center
excluded.reason: Component facility sharing the Memorial Park footprint; not a separate park parent.

excluded.name: Memorial Ballpark
excluded.reason: Component facility sharing the Memorial Park footprint; not a separate park parent.

sourcePolicy.parksPage: The current City Parks page establishes operator scope and links the official park finder.
sourcePolicy.spatialData: The live municipal Parks FeatureServer controls source identity, City ownership/category, address, acreage selection basis, GlobalID, and an approximate representative point.
sourcePolicy.coordinateLimit: FeatureServer centroids are approximate inventory points, not practical arrival coordinates; launch-guide work must replace or verify them against an official visitor entrance.
sourcePolicy.imageRights: No City image is downloaded or imported. The City site is all-rights-reserved and no reusable image license is assumed.
sourcePolicy.geometryRights: No park polygon geometry is copied or redistributed.

publicationGates: Replace or verify each approximate polygon centroid with a practical public arrival point.
Complete current recurring visitor answers for each separately assigned parent.
Obtain representative reusable parent photography with destination identity and attribution.
Recheck operator identity, hours, and any staffed or reservation-controlled facilities before publication.
Do not redistribute City GIS polygon geometry or reuse City images without documented permission.
